// Capture all configuration from environment variables at workflow start
return [{ json: {
  detector_service_url: $env.DETECTOR_SERVICE_URL || 'http://detector:5000',
  omniroute_base_url: $env.OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL || '',
  omniroute_api_key: $env.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY || '',
  primary_model: $env.PRIMARY_MODEL || 'cerebras/llama3.1-8b',
  secondary_model: $env.SECONDARY_MODEL || 'nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct',
  fallback_model: $env.FALLBACK_MODEL || 'openrouter/meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free',
  detector_version: $env.DETECTOR_VERSION || '1.0.0',
  feature_schema_version: $env.FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION || '1.0.0',
  classifier_version: $env.CLASSIFIER_VERSION || '1.0.0',
  threshold_version: $env.THRESHOLD_VERSION || '1.0.0',
  webhook_url: $env.WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://localhost:5678',
  webhook_review_url: $env.WEBHOOK_URL + '/webhook/ai-review-queue' || 'http://localhost:5678/webhook/ai-review-queue',
  min_text_length: parseInt($env.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH || '10'),
  max_text_length: parseInt($env.MAX_TEXT_LENGTH || '50000'),
  statistical_weight: parseFloat($env.STATISTICAL_WEIGHT || '0.60'),
  primary_model_weight: parseFloat($env.PRIMARY_MODEL_WEIGHT || '0.25'),
  secondary_model_weight: parseFloat($env.SECONDARY_MODEL_WEIGHT || '0.15'),
  ai_prob_threshold: parseFloat($env.AI_PROBABILITY_THRESHOLD || '0.85'),
  ai_conf_threshold: parseFloat($env.AI_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD || '0.70'),
  human_prob_threshold: parseFloat($env.HUMAN_PROBABILITY_THRESHOLD || '0.20'),
  human_conf_threshold: parseFloat($env.HUMAN_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD || '0.70'),
  max_disagreement: parseFloat($env.MAX_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT || '0.30')
} }];
